audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: FY2022 net revenue for PepsiCo is $80,949 million
audit_report.rationale: Claim A02 appears without derivation support; the analyst states it was unable to derive 2022 revenue from provided inputs yet still assigned a specific value ($80,949M). This unsubstantiated revenue figure then propagates to the margin calculation (A03: 14,275/80,949=17.63%), making the final margin dependent on an unsupported input. The extractor only provided 2023 revenue (C01), not 2022 revenue, so A02's value lacks proper provenance and is the root cause of potential error in the final margin calculation.
